phases.name: Schedule the beam days with LNL
Two-arm Geant4 config + run plan sim
Repair B's drift window (CEA); new windows optional
DREAM loan: 4 FEUs + TCM, busy LEMO
Bench tests T1–T4 (trigger, prescale, busy lock)
Build holder; Li films; LiOH test on the line
INFN-AAI account, LNL access, RP training
Floor plan, line, gas safety file, GLIMOS
Ship + install at LNL, cosmic commissioning
8 CN working days of beam (June–July 2027; allocation ends 30 Jul)
Full experiment: proposal to the next PAC

milestones.name: Go from Pierfrancesco: feasibility study, ~8 days
Go/no-go: both arms work on cosmics
End of the call's allocation period (20 Feb – 30 Jul 2027)

tasks.t: Send Pierfrancesco the outline, the two-arm numbers and the questions (spokesperson, GLIMOS, author list)

Informal contact with Anna Selva / the Accelerator Division: the CN (AN2000 probably not available, 25 Nov), 1.10 MeV at 1 µA and H₂⁺ at 0.883 MV, hours per working day, line and floor space, June–July 2027 (the call's period ends 30 Jul)
Get the INFN-AAI account + 'Risorse IT' (needed to submit on Indico)
Download the LNL LaTeX template from Indico; move the draft into it; upload to Overleaf
Ask the co-proponents (Massimi, Mengoni, Gervino, Gustavino, Cosentino) to join; collect names + affiliations

Draft v1 in Overleaf: abstract page + body of at most 4 pages (LNL template, 12 pt, figures and references included). 25 Nov: audited against the call and rebuilt around three figures (apparatus + n_TOF data + Geant4 event; the Geant4 predictions; reach and the path to the full experiment), template sections, one rates table; Dylan to proof-read. 26 Nov: reworked for run L19 (limits 4.3 / 5.5 / 7.2 ×, ~200 d to 3σ, the 441 keV day ~70 beam pairs of which a third external conversions, Fig. 2 from the L19 spectra) and the Li film known to ±50 % (rates for 11 µm, thickness from the 1.10 MeV / 441 keV yield ratio, 6.9 / 3.6 × for a film 0.5 / 1.5 × as thick)
Draft to Pierfrancesco; agree the beam-day table and the machine
Circulate to co-proponents; comments by 7 Dec
Freeze text; fill the online Beam Time Request and Targets Request Form (keep the confirmation password)
Submit on Indico (event 50487). Deadline is 10 Dec 23:59 CET
Talk to the LNL ⁸Be spectrometer group (T. Marchi et al.) before submitting: how this complements their AN2000 data
PAC talk: 12 min + 8 min discussion; answer the technical-review points
Two-arm re-reduction of the L11–L13 tables, every pair geometry, new cosmics (L15) and rotated arms (L16): sim2arm/TWO_ARM_STUDY.md (19 Nov)
Proposal figures: two-arm acceptance vs θ, expected spectra (441 keV and 1.10 MeV), rates table
Geant4: two-arm geometry with the real target holder and stand (MX17_Full_Geant branch from lnl_target)

Timing on cosmics with the LNL readout (V1742/CFD): n_TOF beam-off muons give σ_t 0.52–0.64 ns per arm (walls), 0.95 (plastics) with the n_TOF readout (nTof_x17 ac_tof_beamoff, 19 Nov); decides the TOF cut

Proposal text from sim2arm: the 441 keV rate (~140 pairs/day above 90° with the built Cu hemisphere), the reach rows (2.35 × R(ATOMKI) in 5 d, liquid working), the vertical-cosmics test. Done 24 Nov: abstract + body rewritten in Dylan's style, beam request table on the abstract page; pushed to Overleaf
More as-built MC for the Cu hemisphere: done 20 Nov (run L18, ×30 the L10 tables; the 19 Nov study had used the Cu ogive)

Two-arm Geant4 of the lighter Al end piece (Al ogive + Cu liner) from its own tables (L12 + the x30 L13): 21 d to 3 sigma and 0.88 x R(ATOMKI) in 5 d with the liquid working, 1.19 x as at n_TOF, 1.70 x without (11 µm). The old scaling (10 d, 0.62 x) was optimistic. Done 25 Nov (sim2arm/R10_AL_OGIVE.md); the 45° Al cap is not simulated in two arms

Geant4 of the liquid cell right behind the SiPM wall (runs R11 + R11b, 21 Nov): no gain. Own MC (direct) 284 d to 3 sigma vs 189 d for the baseline; X17 acceptance x2.5 (toy x4.2), cosmics x3.5, gamma1 x7; the transplant (47 d) does not apply to this layout. Baseline kept (LIQUID_CELLS.md 4.1)

Geant4 predictions of every observable of the run (trigger and track fractions, cosmic θ/Δt/pointing, beam singles, 441 keV and 1.10 MeV spectra) and a 3D view of real Geant4 events (run L17): Predictions tab, sim2arm/PREDICTIONS.md (20 Nov)
Proposal: the Geant4 event as Fig. 1c (drawn from sim2arm/out/events3d.json by proposal/figsrc/make_figures.py, 25 Nov), the predictions as Fig. 2 and the rates in Table I

n_TOF beam-off A–C wall coincidences: 0.84 Hz measured vs 0.34 Hz in the cosmic toy MC; explain before quoting absolute cosmic rates (the chamber-level factor 2.5 is the reconstruction gate). Impact checked 26 Nov (TA_COS_SCALE=2.5, L19): 195 → 230 d to 3σ, 46 h limit 4.3 → 4.7 × R(ATOMKI), since the beam background dominates the fit region (825 beam vs 72 cosmic pairs per day)
Ask Stephan / CEA: repair B's drift window (needed); new aluminised-mylar windows for A and B (low-budget upgrade); dates

Ask CEA for the DREAM loan for Feb–Jul 2027 (bench from April, beam in July): 4 FEUs + 32 cables from CEA's common pool (the TCM, network card, NIM module and DAQ PC are kept for us at CEA); solder the TCM busy LEMO
Optional (high-budget upgrade): 4 CERN-design M1 cards for B. Slot 1 runs B with its existing Italian M1s
Cosmic bench, 2 MM + DREAM: efficiency, segment angle (μ ≲ 3°), noise with B's existing M1s

Gas choice (gas/GAS_STUDY.md §8, 26 Nov): bench test of chamber A on cosmics in a non-flammable low-quencher premix (Ar/iC₄H₁₀ 98.2/1.8 or Ar/CH₄ 96/4 at ~175 V/cm, ~550 V on B) against Ar/CO₂/iC₄H₁₀ 96.5/2/1.5 at ~220 V/cm: gain + spark scan, drift scan 100–250 V/cm, angle resolution and efficiency against the June 95/5 runs, with the water measured. Decide the gas from it; ~2 bottles, ~1 week (ask CEA)
Find PMTs for the 4 small plastics + 2 for the liquid cells (PF, 20 Nov: PMTs are short)
Digitizers: ~24 channels (16 wall + 4–6 PMT + trigger word) from LNL pool; else ask CAEN for a test loan

Borrow list (25 Nov): LEMO cables + Ts from n_TOF (very likely, returned after the run); 2 N1081B, the N93B, 3–4 linear FIFOs, a NIM bin and the Delta SM3545-D LV rented from the CERN electronics pool and taken to LNL (hopefully); splitters + adapters bought
Bench tests T1, T2, T4 (prescaler, busy lock 1:1, trigger word)
Liquid cells decided (PF + Dylan, 20 Nov): the proposal assumes 2 cells, 2 cm thick, one per arm, in new cans (the simulated 'liquid working': 2.35 × R(ATOMKI) in 5 d; 4.3 × without)

Thicker liquid cells: Geant4 scan 2 / 2+2 in series / 4 / 5 cm (PF: '4 cm in parallel or 2 cm in series'); expose the LS dimensions on the MX17_Full_Geant command line (slot1_feasibility/LIQUID_CELLS.md §2)

Wider liquid cells to replace the big plastics, within ~60 L: oversized-cell Geant4 run at 35/41/47 cm (60–80 cm sides need 27–56 L for 2 arms, ~53 L for 4 arms at 60 × 60 × 3 cm); trigger leg, light collection, PMTs (LIQUID_CELLS.md §3)
Ask PF: how much liquid (~60 L?), which liquid, who remakes the cans and when, how many PMTs; '4 cm in parallel / 2 cm in series': per arm or in total?
Remake 2 liquid-cell cans (45 × 45 × 2 cm baseline, or the S6/S7 design) and fill them

Target for the proposal: pressed Li on Cu (CN group), 10–12 µm; holder: the Cu hemisphere (already built: R 11 mm, 300 µm, rim; simulated as dome300 since 20 Nov, the 19 Nov numbers used the Cu ogive by mistake); a lighter Al end piece (Al ogive + Cu liner, or a flat Al end cap at 45°) would cut the days ×7 in simulation (R10: 21 d against 151 d to 3σ, liquid working): ask whether one can be made for slot 1. PF (20 Nov): the hemisphere exists and works, 'at least for the forward angles'; he has asked for an engineering thesis on the holder

What a ±50 % uncertainty on the Li film's thickness and homogeneity does (slot1_feasibility/LI_THICKNESS.md, sim2arm/li_thickness.py): yields, LiOH, reach for 17 film scenarios; in-situ measurement from the 1.10 MeV / 441 keV yield ratio

External conversions at x100 statistics (sim2arm/EPC_L19.md, 26 Nov): run L19, 3e10 ⁸Be γ in the built Cu hemisphere, 6,000 clean jobs. Selected EPC pairs on 352 MC events (was 2): 21/day at 1.10 MeV (was 17), 74/day at 441 keV (was 1.4); signal-like θ shape, so 195 d to 3σ (was 151) and 4.3 × R(ATOMKI) in the 46 h (was 3.8 ×; 5.5 / 7.2 × as at n_TOF / no liquid). Proposal numbers updated 26 Nov (P5). Follow-ups 26 Nov: the full reach grid with L19 (sim2arm/run_l19_full.sh, run_l19_all.sh: tags _pass4{,li11}_l19, now read by two_arm_estimates and the page); the reference row reproduced (195 / 320 / 551 d); muon segments at 3° instead of 15° gain only 6 % (184 d); 4 µA gives 2.0 × in the 46 h (was 1.7 ×)

External conversions of the lighter Al holder (Al ogive + Cu liner) at L19 statistics (~5,000 core-h, test cluster first): R10's 21 days to 3σ and the proposal's 'factor of 9' and '1.4–1.9 × in 46 h' rest on 2 simulated EPC events, and L19 showed the EPC shape is signal-like (Cu: 151 → 195 d). Needed before the text freeze (P8) if the Al holder stays in the proposal

How well does Geant4 predict the external conversions that reach two OPPOSITE arms? They need a large-angle scatter in the 300 µm Cu wall (87 % start in the dome, 15 % of the window pairs in the arms' own scintillators/PCBs) and are the largest beam component in the fit region (308 of 825 per day). Day 8 (arms at 90°) measures the dome conversion rate, not this tail; the 441 keV day measures it directly (25 of ~70 pairs) only if H₂⁺ exists. Check: a second EM physics option and the wall-thickness tolerance on an L19-size subsample; ask PF for the measured wall thickness

Day-1 film check procedure (LI_THICKNESS.md §6): γ₀ yield per µC at 1.10 MeV vs 441 keV with the LaBr₃ (the ratio gives the thickness in the spot), 478 keV PIGE as the fallback without H₂⁺, the 17.64/18.15 share as the LiOH alarm; replace a film below ~0.7 × nominal or above a few % 17.64 share. Write the thresholds into the run plan; needs the LaBr₃ efficiency at 478 keV and 17–18 MeV
Build the holder; make films; a week of LiOH-conversion test on the line
LNL access: registration ≥ 15 d ahead, RP training certificate, dosimeters, responsibility declaration
Safety file: non-flammable argon premix bottles in the hall (ISO 10156; the 95/5 plan was flammable), gas panel, exhaust, O₂-deficiency check (gas/GAS_STUDY.md §2)
Floor plan of the line: ~1.5 × 1.5 m around the target, beam height, cable path to the control room, network
Full chain on cosmics: 2 arms, DREAM + digitizers on one event list, run control, slow control Tier 1
Ship, install, commission on cosmics at LNL: ≥ 3 nights with the arms VERTICAL (σ_t, μ segment angle, MIP gains, each cosmic veto), then roll to horizontal
8 CN working days of beam (8 h each, assumed) + beam-off cosmic nights; shift list sent to RP ≥ 3 days ahead
Which commission and when are the requests due? (Pierfrancesco wrote 'commission II'; INFN preventivi are usually prepared in summer: ask)
Full-experiment proposal (4 arms, big plastics) to the next LNL PAC, with the feasibility results

questions.q: Spokesperson(s) and GLIMOS for the abstract page? (GLIMOS is normally local.)

CN instead of AN2000 (25 Nov): the proposal asks 8 working days on the CN at 1 µA (the 8-day allocation), 8 h of beam per working day: 7 at 1.10 MeV + 1 with H₂⁺ for 441 keV (else also 1.10 MeV). Is that how the CN works (hours per day, nights, weekends)? (slot1_feasibility/CN_BEAM.md)

Can the CN give more than 1 µA at 1.10 MeV? The beam sheet says 1 µA at 0.8–2 MeV; the CN paper's ~4 µA limit is set by neutrons, and ⁷Li(p,n) makes none below 1.88 MeV. With the 46 h at 1.10 MeV, 4 µA would bring the limit from 4.3 to 2.0 × R(ATOMKI) (L19, 26 Nov; CN_BEAM.md §3); nights would bring 4.3 to 2.66 ×.
Target for the proposal: pressed Li on Cu in the existing Cu hemisphere: confirm it fits the CN line end?
Can the stand roll 90° about the beam? Plan (sim2arm): vertical pair for the cosmic nights before the beam, horizontal for the beam days.

Liquid scintillator: how many litres (~60 L?), which liquid, who remakes the cans and by when, how many PMTs? '4 cm in parallel or 2 cm in series': per arm or in total? Wider cells could replace the big plastics (LIQUID_CELLS.md).
The holder thesis: when would a student start, and could a lighter end piece exist before the June–July 2027 run?

A γ-yield monitor (LaBr₃ or NaI) from the LNL pool for the target's daily check? A LaBr₃ is preferred: it separates 17.64 from 18.15 MeV (the alarm for a film that reaches 441 keV) and sees the 478 keV line (the Li content, PIGE).

Li films (LI_THICKNESS.md, 25 Nov): can LNL measure each film's thickness and uniformity before the run (RBS / NRA / PIGE at a few spots, or weighing)? How long does a film change take on the CN line, and how many spare films can we have?
'Commission II': which INFN commission, and when must the request be in? Results before that date?
Author list: affiliations for Massimi, Mengoni, Gervino, Gustavino, Cosentino; anyone else (n_TOF, CEA, Torino)?
A CN line (−15°, 0° or +15°, for the full current) ending in ~1.5 × 1.5 m of free floor; beam height; 1 µA at 1.10 MeV on a ~5 mm spot?
CN hours: how many hours of beam per working day (the proposal assumes 8)? Nights or weekends with authorisation (8 × 24 h would give 5 days of beam at 1.10 MeV, as in the AN2000 plan)?

H₂⁺ from the CN source at 0.883 MV (two 0.441 MeV protons), up to 0.5 µA? The proposal asks it as a question and says we expect some D⁺ (same mass); the D⁺ level is worth asking but may have no answer. The 441 keV calibration depends on H₂⁺; the proposal does not.

Answered 25 Nov: the call allocates 20 Feb – 30 Jul 2027 (the call page prints 2026, a typo), so we aim for June or July 2027 (proposal changed). Still to ask: does LNL prefer June or July for the CN, and what happens if we are not ready by July (the next period, autumn 2027)?
Body length: the template says 4 pages, the LNL submission page says 5. The draft keeps to 4: is that what people do?

Gas: we plan a non-flammable argon premix (Ar/iC₄H₁₀ 98.2/1.8 or Ar/CH₄ 96/4; ISO 10156 non-flammable). Does LNL agree with the classification, what does it need for bottles in the hall (storage, exhaust, O₂ monitor), and does LNL stock argon premixes?
Repair B's drift window by March 2027 (and 2 new windows, if cheap)? Lend 4 FEUs + TCM for Mar–Jul 2027?

Can rented modules go to LNL for ~2 months (mid-June to mid-August 2027): 2 × N1081B, the N93B, 3–4 linear FIFOs, a NIM bin and the Delta SM3545-D LV (and digitizers, if LNL has none)? Catalogue fees ~285 CHF/month for the set (epool, 25 Nov 2026).
Lend the LEMO cables (~60 × 16 ns, 60 × 5 ns, 20 × 2 ns, 20 × 1 ns) and ~30 LEMO Ts for Mar–Jul 2027, returned after the run?
Is the large NIM module kept with DREAM a NIM bin with room for our trigger modules? Can 4 FEUs + 32 cables come out of the common pool for Mar–Jul 2027?
A test loan of a V1742 or 2 × V1730 + 2 N1081B for the run (Pierfrancesco's suggestion)?
Status of their 2023–24 AN2000 data; is a joint or complementary run welcome; is the AN2000 room free?
Can we borrow the 4 small plastics' PMTs again (or which PMTs fit them)?

risks.r: Drift cathodes do not hold the field the gas needs (A sparked at 800 V at n_TOF), or water in the gas above 0.5 %
risks.m: Gas chosen for ≤ 700 V on B (≤ 224 V/cm): the low-quencher premixes peak at ~175 V/cm with 0.1–0.5 % water (gas/GAS_STUDY.md). Low-permeation lines, a dryer and a water sensor are critical; above 0.5 % water every candidate's v moves by > 30 %, so v is then calibrated in situ from the cathode edge of the drift-time distribution.

risks.r: Micromegas B not repaired in time
risks.m: Likely just an electrical connection on the drift (Dylan, 19 Nov). A is ready now; C re-bulk as the spare; one-arm-plus-scintillator fallback still gives the 441 keV and background programme.

risks.r: DREAM not available in Mar–Jul 2027 (CEA's own use)
risks.m: Ask now (M2); 4 FEUs is half the system; fix dates with CEA before the PAC talk.
Two arms need ~24, PM can find 10–20; CAEN loan; ganged walls keep it at 8 per wall.

risks.r: No H₂⁺ beam on the CN, so no 441 keV calibration
risks.m: Without it the H₂⁺ day is also at 1.10 MeV (the request stays 8 working days). The energy scale then comes from the 18.15 MeV pairs; the run loses its transition without an expected anomaly, the in-beam film thickness from the 1.10 MeV / 441 keV yield ratio (fallback: 478 keV PIGE, T4) and the direct test of the holder's opposite-arm conversions at 17.64 MeV (a third of the 441 keV pairs, R14).

risks.r: CN gives fewer beam hours than assumed (8 h per working day) or a shorter block
risks.m: With 8 working days of 8 h the run has 46 h at 1.10 MeV: 4.3 × R(ATOMKI) (2.66 × with 24 h days; L19, 26 Nov). The reach scales as the square root of the hours. Ask for night running (P2); nights are cosmic data in any case.

risks.r: The built Cu hemisphere limits the physics reach
risks.m: Simulated (sim2arm; external conversions from run L19, 26 Nov): with the hemisphere's 300 µm wall five days give 2.7 × R(ATOMKI) (liquid working), above MEG II's limit, and the 46 h give 4.3 ×; the holder's conversions are signal-like. A lighter Al end piece (Al ogive + Cu liner) gives 0.9–1.2 × in five days (Geant4, R10, 25 Nov; its conversions rest on 2 MC events: R13). Ask PF whether one can be made (T1); otherwise sell the run as the feasibility test it is.

risks.r: Cosmic veto weaker than simulated (σ_t > 0.4 ns, segments worse than 3°)
risks.m: n_TOF beam-off muons: σ_t 0.52–0.64 ns per arm (19 Nov). Horizontal pair for the beam days: its days barely depend on σ_t (17.4 d with no TOF, 17.7 at any σ_t; sim2arm tof_scan); the vertical pair goes 17.1 → 18.7 d from 0.3 to 0.7 ns. R4 with the LNL readout.

risks.r: Liquid-cell cans not remade in time, or PMTs not found
risks.m: The proposal assumes them (4.3 × R(ATOMKI) in the 46 h; 2.66 × in 5 d); without them 7.2 × (4.5 × in 5 d), the run stays a feasibility test. Ask now (S8); the n_TOF cans as a fallback if they can be reused.
10–12 µm films; γ-yield monitor each day; a spare film; a week's conversion test before the run.

risks.r: Li film thickness and homogeneity known only to ~50 % (whatever film is made)
risks.m: slot1_feasibility/LI_THICKNESS.md (25 Nov): the γ rate follows the mean thickness, so the 46 h limit spans 6.9 × (0.5 × 11 µm) to 3.55 × (1.5 ×) around 4.3 × R(ATOMKI) (with the L19 external conversions); an uneven film with the right mean costs 3–18 % in days. The danger is unevenness plus LiOH: thick spots reach 441 keV (36 % of γ₀ from 17.64 MeV at ±50 % spread and half the Li converted; days × 2.3–3.7). Measure the film on day 1 (γ₀ yield ratio 1.10 MeV / 441 keV, which does not depend on the film; 478 keV PIGE), watch 17.64/18.15 with the LaBr₃, bring spare films, map films by IBA before the run if LNL can. R stays normalised to the γ monitor, so the thickness changes only the statistics.

risks.r: Machine-future decision (one machine to replace AN2000 + CN)
risks.m: Run in 2027 is unaffected; follow the decision (x17_facility_search/lnl/NOTE_CN_AN2000_REPLACEMENT.md).

risks.r: Not ready by July: only ~5 months from the PAC (late Jan) to the end of the allocation period (30 Jul 2027)
risks.m: Moved from H2 2027 to June–July on 25 Nov (the call covers 20 Feb – 30 Jul). Go/no-go on cosmics by 14 May; B's window and the DREAM loan asked before the PAC (M1, M2); the hardware asks go out in December. If the go/no-go fails, ask LNL to move the 8 days to the next period (autumn 2027, after the August closure).

risks.r: Proposal deadline missed (next call ~a year later)
risks.m: Draft by 27 Nov; submit 9 Dec; get the INFN-AAI account this week.

beam.what: Installation weeks, VERTICAL pair: ≥ 3 nights of cosmics with the full trigger. Measures the arm-to-arm time of flight (σ_t), each arm's MIP gain and the rejection of every cosmic veto, in the worst geometry

Roll to the HORIZONTAL pair. Beam on target at low current; current scan 0.05 → 1 µA (~2 h): trigger rates, DREAM live time, Micromegas occupancy, singles; γ-yield reference; then ~6 h in the 18.15 MeV region

H₂⁺ at 0.883 MV (two 0.441 MeV protons), IF the CN can provide it: 17.64 MeV M1 IPC, ~70 selected beam pairs in 8 h (44 M1, 25 external conversions, run L19; rate to ~14 %), opening-angle shape, energy scale and the holder's conversions at 17.64 MeV; the 1.10 MeV / 441 keV γ₀ yield ratio gives the film thickness. Otherwise this day is at 1.10 MeV
18.15 MeV region: IPC spectrum, X17 window (40 h; 46 h with day 1 = 1.9 days of beam); γ-yield check each day
Arms ADJACENT (90°): small-angle IPC and external conversions (~500 pairs in 8 h)
Every night and the weekend without beam: cosmics with the full trigger in the physics geometry (~45 selected pairs per 16-hour night)
